name: 3D Spatial Grouping Network
aliases: Stage 2 Network for 3D Serialization and Grouping
definition: A Stage 2 network for 3D serialization and grouping of Gaussians, using space-filling curves and local attention.
summary: The 3D Spatial Grouping Network refines 3D Gaussian Splatting tokens using local attention on space-filling curve serialized groups, efficiently handling sparse point cloud sparsity.
